# BarangayBooks — AI crawler fact sheet

## Name
BarangayBooks

## What it does
BarangayBooks is a web-based ledger for Philippine Homeowners Associations (HOAs) and community officers.

- Collect monthly dues automatically with per-household statements of account.
- Verify payments with photo proof uploaded by members (GCash, Maya, or bank-deposit receipts).
- Send reminders and track delinquencies in real time.
- Export audit-ready reports: contributions, expenses, delinquency, and household lists to PDF, Excel, and CSV.
- Provide role-based access for treasurers, barangay admins, board members, and members.

## Pricing
- Community: ₱199 PHP / month — up to 50 households.
- Barangay: ₱499 PHP / month — up to 250 households (most popular).
- City: ₱999 PHP / month — unlimited households, includes API access.
- Free during beta for founding HOAs; every paid plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
